note: Independent re-judgment against RFC 5176 Section 6.3 and HEAD code (coa.go answerRequest, eventTimestampState). TestRFC5176StaleEventTimestampDiscarded sends an otherwise valid Disconnect-Request with Event-Timestamp two replay windows in the past and asserts silent discard (no response) and zero teardowns, then sends the same request with a current Event-Timestamp and asserts Disconnect-ACK. Note: future-dated timestamps (checked by ts.After in eventTimestampState) are not exercised.
